questions.stem: A male patient of 32 years was admitted to the emergency department, with a lot of injuries seen on his face and head region with bleeding. His relatives told the doctor that he had been injured in a roadside accident. On examination, the doctor found severe bleeding from the nose along with some watery fluid. After 3 days, on examination, it was found that the patient is having unilateral anosmia. Which cranial nerve is damaged in this case and what is the reason for the anosmia?

options.label: A
options.text: Optic nerve; anosmia due to damage to the orbicularis oculi in the accident

options.label: B
options.text: Olfactory nerve; anosmia due to damaged olfactory nerve rootlets

options.label: C
options.text: Olfactory nerve; anosmia due to damaged nasal septum
